results.releaseNotes:
This update brings several improvements to make the experience more stable and reliable:

Gold Card: Fixed an issue where the underworld view was not saved correctly when using the Gold Card.
Tap areas: We've reworked touch and click targets throughout the app. Elements now respond more accurately to input — safe areas are correctly recalculated after tapping.
Tutor: Fixed an issue with the tutor's start and end points, so the guided introduction now runs smoothly from beginning to end.
New visuals: Updated artwork and images have been integrated.

We've also made additional stability improvements under the hood.
results.description:
The official Flip & Write companion to the board game hit!

Step into the shoes of a royal cartographer and surveyor commissioned by Queen Gimnax. Your mission: explore, stake out, and immortalize the wild northern lands on parchment. In this strategic card game, you decide how to shape your territory—but beware: you are not alone in the wilderness!

An Epic Adventure in the Roll Player Universe
Cartographers brings the fascinating mechanics of the modern board game directly to your smartphone. Experience the tactical Flip & Write principle that has thrilled critics and fans worldwide and was nominated for the prestigious Kennerspiel des Jahres (Connoisseur Game of the Year) in 2020.

Strategy Through Ever-Changing Decrees
At the heart of this board game are four royal decrees. These are recombined in every match, making each game a unique puzzle. You must constantly adapt your strategy to squeeze the maximum score out of your lands:

Diverse Scoring: Earn fame through the Gloomy Wood by skillfully enclosing forest patches, or use the Golden Granary to place farm fields on valuable ruins.

Tactical Placement: In the Magician's Valley, score points by placing water and farmland near mighty mountains. Every hamlet and settlement must be cleverly planned to meet the Queen’s shifting demands.

Seasonal Cycle: Priorities change through Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter. Only those who plan ahead will be named Master Cartographer at the end of the year.

The Gameplay is Simple
Flip: Each round, a new card is revealed, showing you landscapes and shapes.

Write: Skillfully place these areas on your map. Use the space optimally to fulfill the conditions of the decrees.

Score: Collect valuable reputation points, but watch out for monster ambushes!

Monsters in the Borderlands
A cartographer must be brave! The monsters never sleep. At regular intervals, you will encounter ambushes that thwart your plans. Monster fields will be discovered on your map—surround them quickly to minimize the damage to your reputation.

Why You’ll Love "Cartographers":
Official Adaptation: The faithful digital version of the popular board game by Thunderworks Games.

Weekly Challenges: Compete with players from all over the world in global highscore lists. A new scenario awaits you every week!

Three Game Modes: Choose between different difficulty levels and randomness factors—from relaxed puzzling to hardcore strategy.

Achievements & Ranks: Collect achievements and rise from apprentice to legendary Royal Cartographer.

Solo Fun & Competition: Perfect for a quick round in between or a deep strategic experience.

Awards for the Original:
2020 – Kennerspiel des Jahres Nominee

2019 – Golden Geek Best Solo Board Game Nominee

2019 – Golden Geek Best Family Board Game Nominee

2019 – Cardboard Republic Socializer Laurel Nominee

Are you ready to expand the borders of the realm? Grab your quill, draw your cards, and master the ultimate Flip & Write adventure. Whether you're a fan of board games, logic puzzles, or fantasy strategy, Cartographers offers tactical depth right in your pocket.

Download the official app now and begin your journey through the northern lands!
